My year 2 sem 1 module reviews

This semester I took four modules. Here is how each one went, with my honest thoughts on workload, assessment and whether I would recommend them to a junior.

CS2040S Data Structures and Algorithms

CS2040S was the heaviest module of the semester by far. Weekly problem sets took me between eight and twelve hours each, on top of lectures and tutorials. The assessment was split across problem sets, a midterm, two programming assignments and a final exam. The final was fair but the time pressure was intense.

The content is genuinely useful. Every later CS module assumes you know this material cold, so it is worth putting the hours in. Tip: do the practice problems on Kattis early in the semester and form a study group for the problem sets.

MA1521 Calculus

Light workload, mostly past-year-paper practice. Bell curve is generous.
